verdict.rationale: Paxos has a dedicated AI-assisted development page that documents both llms.txt and llms-full.txt for AI tools. A live probe confirmed llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking to markdown versions of the docs pages, so an agent can be pointed directly at it. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that llms-full.txt is actually served.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.paxos.com/llms.txt # Paxos Documentation
The `llms.txt` file is an industry standard that helps AI tools index content more efficiently, similar to how a sitemap helps search engines.
The `llms-full.txt` file combines the entire documentation site into a single file as context for AI tools.
